claimant_lives_in_uk.description: Whether the claimant lives in the UK.

children.description: A list of children the claimant is claiming for.

lives_with_claimant.description: Whether the child lives with the claimant.

in_approved_education.description: Whether the child is in approved education or training (e.g. A-levels, GCSEs, NVQ up to level 3). Only relevant for children aged 16-19.

in_extension_period.description: Whether the child (aged 16 or 17) has left education and registered with a government-sponsored careers service or the armed forces (qualifying for a 20-week extension).

upkeep_per_week.description: The amount in £ per week the claimant contributes towards the child's upkeep (food, clothes, pocket money, etc.). Only relevant if the child does not live with the claimant.

another_claimant_has_priority.description: Whether another person who also lives with the child has priority for claiming Child Benefit.

another_claimant_lives_with_child.description: Whether someone who lives with the child is already claiming Child Benefit for them.

care_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in local authority care.

care_home_24h_per_week.description: Whether the child spends at least 24 hours per week at home while in local authority care.

hospital_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in hospital or residential accommodation.

claimant_spends_on_child.description: Whether the claimant regularly spends money on the child (e.g. food, clothes, books) while the child is in hospital or residential accommodation.

is_fostered.description: Whether the child is fostered by the claimant.

council_pays_for_child.description: Whether the local council pays towards the child's accommodation or maintenance.

works_24_plus_hours.description: Whether the child works 24 or more hours per week in paid employment.

started_apprenticeship_in_england.description: Whether the child has started an apprenticeship in England.

receives_qualifying_benefits.description: Whether the child receives qualifying benefits in their own right, such as Universal Credit or Employment and Support Allowance.

conversation.text:
Hello! I'd be happy to help you determine if you're eligible for Child Benefit. To assess your eligibility, I'll need to gather some information about you and your children.

Let me start with a basic question:

**How many children are you inquiring about, and what are their names?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Hello! I'm inquiring about my child. His name is Alex.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for that information! So you're inquiring about **Alex**.

Before I can assess eligibility, I need to gather a bit more information about Alex.

**How old is Alex, or what is his date of birth?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Alex is 8 years old.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you. So Alex is 8 years old.

**Does Alex live with you?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, Alex lives with me at home.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Good, thank you for confirming that.

**Are you a UK resident, and do you have a National Insurance number or are you eligible to work in the UK?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, I live in the UK and I'm eligible to work here.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for that confirmation.

**Are you a British citizen, or if not, what is your immigration status in the UK?** (For example, are you a EU citizen, have settled status, visa status, etc.)

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: I'm a British citizen.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Excellent, thank you for clarifying that.

**Do you receive any social security benefits from outside the UK, or are you considered a "person from abroad" under UK benefit rules?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: No, I don't receive any benefits from outside the UK.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for that information.

Now let me ask about Alex's circumstances:

**Has Alex ever been in local authority care, or is Alex currently in hospital or residential care?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: No, Alex hasn't been in care or hospital.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for confirming that.

**Is Alex in full-time education or training, or does Alex have any disability that affects their entitlement?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Alex is 8 years old, so he's in primary school.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for that clarification.

I have one final question:

**Is there anyone else who might also be claiming Child Benefit for Alex, such as Alex's other parent or another guardian?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: No, there's nobody else claiming Child Benefit for Alex.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text: Thank you for providing all that information. Let me now read the official eligibility guidance to make my final assessment.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text: Perfect! I now have all the information I need to make my assessment. Based on the information you've provided and the official eligibility rules, let me provide my conclusion:

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
**Great news! You are eligible to claim Child Benefit for Alex.**

You meet all the requirements:
- Alex is 8 years old (under 16)
- You live in the UK and are a British citizen
- Alex lives with you
- You are responsible for Alex
- There are no other claims for Child Benefit on Alex's behalf

You can now apply for Child Benefit. If you have any further questions or need additional information, please feel free to ask!
